wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 05-007 wires the DEMO<n>-named demo lumps and the per-map 10-lump bundles into a runtime catalog the attract-loop scheduler and the per-level setup pipeline consume. The new wrapper at src/vanilla/demoAndMapAssets.ts walks the IwadResourceCache directory partitioning every committed lump starting with DEMO into the demo bucket and delegates to the read-only findMapNames helper for map-marker detection. The catalog does not parse demo or map payloads at build time — that concern belongs to the demo player and mapSetup at level-load time. No proprietary IWAD bytes are embedded.
